title: Reading the Second Register
statement: For a configuration $c$, a state $s$, distinct work-tape indices $r_1,r_2$, and an integer $k$, change the state to $s$ and place both work-tape heads at $k$, leaving the tapes and all other configuration data unchanged. The symbol read at the second head is then the content of tape $r_2$ at cell $k$.
